Name: ABetterCrabTrap
Author: ARgoChxw
Description:
事实上，我自己都不用这个模组，而是使用了更好的一个。推荐给你，请不要使用我写的这个了。
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38969

In fact, I’ve found the crab trap module that brings all my ideas to life — it’s the best crab trap module out there right now, and I’m currently using it.
The link above.

---

因为熏鱼机的到来，和我们基因里捕鱼的快乐，如果还可以自动化，那就更快乐的不要不要的了。所以是时候，让蟹笼也能捕鱼了。

所有钓鱼等级，有1%概率出3种凝胶，所有物品有10%概率数量为2件。
随着钓鱼等级提升，会出鲶鱼、大海参、熔岩鳗鱼，最终比例6%、3%和1%；这三种鱼还有质量加成，银星：金星：铱星=3:3:4。
现在的终极收益，略高于酿酒。且因为出凝胶，整个体系闭环了。

当蟹笼捕获到珍惜鱼类时，不再是统一的5点经验。
1.当捕获到鲶鱼、大海参、岩浆鳗鱼时候会获得50、75、150点经验。进行质量加成时，银星、金星、铱星还有10、20、30点经验。
2.当捕获到小鱼时，15点经验。前期就靠这15点升级了。

本mod强烈建议配合Automate使用，手动使用鱼的数量不增加，还会报不影响游戏的错。因为我几乎都用自动化mod，暂时就不修改了。

mod的关键代码来自CrabPotQuality(7767）。

以下是英文自动翻译，和上文相同。

The above is in Chinese, with the same meaning as in Machine translated English below.

Because of the arrival of the smoked fish machine and the joy of fishing in our genes, if it can still be automated, then it would be even happier not to give up. So it's time to let the crab cage also catch fish.

For all fishing levels, there is a 1% probability that three gel will be produced, and there is a 10% probability that the number of all items will be two.
As the fishing level increases, catfish, sea cucumbers, and lava eels will emerge, with a final proportion of 6%, 3%, and 1%; These three types of fish also have a mass bonus, Silver Star: Venus: Iridium Star=3:3:4.
The ultimate profit now is slightly higher than that of brewing. And because of the gel, the whole system is closed loop.

When crab cages catch precious fish, it is no longer a unified 5-point experience.
When catching catfish, sea cucumbers, and magma eels, you will gain 50, 75, and 150 experience points. When adding quality bonuses, Silver, Venus, and Iridium still have 10, 20, and 30 points of experience.
When catching small fish, gain 15 points of experience. I upgraded based on these 15 points in the early stage.

It is strongly recommended to use this mod in conjunction with Automation. The number of fish used manually will not increase, and there will be errors that do not affect the game. Because I mostly use automated mods, I won't make any changes for now.

The key code for mod comes from CrabPotQuality (7767).
